scope: Updated pytest expectations for execution-gated module architecture

updated_expectations.expectation: Disabled module execution returns 403 MODULE_DISABLED and creates no job.
Missing or deleted key binding returns 403 API_KEY_BINDING_MISSING and fails safely.
Request/job payloads contain only non-sensitive execution metadata; key material is injected only inside backend execution.
Tests copy primitive field snapshots before closing SQLAlchemy sessions.
Integration tests run only after Alembic on an isolated reachable PostgreSQL database; unavailable DB skips gracefully outside integration mode.
